item.title: An 18-year-old boy was battling a mystery illness until a pregnancy test helped save his life
item.description: Byron Geldard was just 18 years old when he began experiencing a persistent, sharp pain in his side. Like many active teenagers, he initially brushed it off as a minor injury from his time at the gym. However, when the pain refused to subside, he sought medical advice, beginning a journey that would eventually go viral for its highly unusual diagnostic method.“Because I was going to the gym, it was just put down to muscle pain,” Geldard recalled. Unfortunately, the reality was far more serious.
